title: Drop redundant email lookup in UserSchema
bug: Duplicate emails now fail with a raw database integrity error instead of a validation error.

findings.label: regression
findings.why: The PR description doesn't announce this change. Removing the validate_email method removes the application-level duplicate email check, so the validation error for duplicate email no longer appears in the response body.

findings.label: regression
findings.why: The PR description doesn't announce this change. With the application-level check removed, duplicate email attempts now hit the database UNIQUE constraint, which returns a database integrity error instead of a validation error.

findings.label: regression
findings.why: The PR description doesn't announce this change. With the application-level check removed, duplicate email attempts now hit the database UNIQUE constraint, which returns a database integrity error instead of a validation error.

doppel_guided.summary: The PR intentionally removes the redundant application-level duplicate email validation, causing duplicate email attempts to fail at the database UNIQUE constraint instead of the validation layer.

suspicions.claim: Registering a new user with an email that already exists in the database now returns a 500 Internal Server Error instead of a 400 validation error with message 'Use a different email.'
suspicions.trigger: Send POST /api/users with JSON body containing username, email (duplicate of existing user), password, and about_me. Observe response status code and error structure.
suspicions.evidence: Probe round2 probe_s1_duplicate_email_register sent POST /api/users with duplicate email; base returned 400 with validation error 'Use a different email.' while head returned 400 with description 'UNIQUE constraint failed: users.email' and message 'Database integrity error'.

suspicions.claim: Updating the authenticated user's email to an email already used by another user now returns a 500 Internal Server Error instead of a 400 validation error with message 'Use a different email.'
suspicions.trigger: Authenticate as a user (e.g., alice with password doppel-pass), then send PUT /api/me with JSON body containing email set to another user's email (e.g., bob@example.com). Observe response status code and error structure.
suspicions.evidence: Probe round2 probe_s2_duplicate_email_update_me authenticated as alice then sent PUT /api/me with bob's email; base returned 400 with validation error 'Use a different email.' while head returned 400 with description 'UNIQUE constraint failed: users.email' and message 'Database integrity error'.
